issues_detected.description: No variables, parent_datasets, top-level resources or regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level; ~71% of Q1 fields populated.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add variable-level metadata (at least per modality), a structured confidentiality level and top-level resources.

issues_detected.description: Processing strategies name no conversion/mapping software, versions or URLs (fda/sdt to DICOM, FIT to Open mHealth, REDCap to OMOP CDM).
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the conversion and ETL software with versions and repository URLs for each modality.

issues_detected.description: No errata or long-term preservation commitment; version_details states DOI-bearing version 2.0.0 is no longer accessible.
issues_detected.recommendation: State a preservation commitment for released versions, add errata, and explain the withdrawal of version 2.0.0.

issues_detected.description: No formal dataset citation; associated publications (BMJ Open protocol, Nature Metabolism comment) are named without identifiers.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a formal dataset citation and identifiers (DOIs) for the BMJ Open protocol and Nature Metabolism comment.

issues_detected.description: intended_uses and discouraged_uses absent; future_use_impacts holds one risk without mitigation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate intended and discouraged uses and pair each identified risk with a mitigation.

issues_detected.description: Lineage only partial: no was_derived_from/parent links and conversion paths stated for only some modalities.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document per-modality derivation paths (raw format, activity, agent/tool, released format).

issues_detected.description: Single typed bias; no standard-taxonomy categorization or fairness analysis.
issues_detected.recommendation: Categorize further biases (measurement, device, site, sampling) with a standard taxonomy and add a fairness analysis.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified.method states NoDeIdentification (no identifiers collected) while identifiers_removed says sex, race/ethnicity and medications were removed and a source cites Safe Harbor; the record documents the conflict in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile the deidentification method across sources or state which applies to the public release.

issues_detected.description: data_use_permission is disease_specific_research while license_terms grant research, commercial and non-commercial use; recorded transparently as a source conflict.
issues_detected.recommendation: Clarify whether the public release is limited to type 2 diabetes research or permits commercial use.

issues_detected.description: human_subject_research is true but at_risk_populations and data_protection_impacts are not populated (source_caveats says no DPIA was conducted).
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate at_risk_populations and record the DPIA status in data_protection_impacts.

issues_detected.description: Source documents disagree on year labels for releases (README 'year 3 data' vs healthsheet first/second year); recorded as caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Harmonize the release year labels or explain the differing conventions.

semantic_insights: Record is source-transparent: conflicts (license naming, deidentification method, grant typo, version wording) are recorded in source_caveats rather than silently resolved.
Temporal ordering is consistent: pilot enrollment 2023-07-18, v3 collection 2023-07-19 to 2025-05-01, release 2025-11-17; versions 1.0.0 (2024-05-03), 2.0.0 (2024-11-08), 3.0.0 (2025-11-17).
Public vs controlled-access tiers are distinguished; 'public download' is correctly qualified by verified-ID login and license self-attestation.
Human subjects logic holds: involves_human_subjects true with ethical_reviews and informed_consent populated.
